data.name: Pakistan Telecommunication Company Ltd
data.description: Pakistan Telecommunication Company Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on December 31, 1995 and commenced business on January 01, 1996. The Company provides telecommunication services in Pakistan. It owns and operates telecommunication facilities and provides domestic and international telephone services and other communication facilities throughout Pakistan. The Company has also been licensed to provide such services in territories of Azad Jammu and Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan.
